title: telemetry
description: Controller state from ESP32. Origin (0,0) = plate center, x to the right, y up (camera view), units mm. u_* = PID output (plate tilt, degrees) after saturation.

x_mm.description: Ball x mm. Limit +-200 mm is a PLACEHOLDER.

y_mm.description: Ball y mm. Limit +-200 mm is a PLACEHOLDER.

sp_x_mm.description: Setpoint x mm. Limit +-200 mm is a PLACEHOLDER.

sp_y_mm.description: Setpoint y mm. Limit +-200 mm is a PLACEHOLDER.

u_x_deg.description: Tilt output x degrees. Limit +-15 deg is a PLACEHOLDER.

u_y_deg.description: Tilt output y degrees. Limit +-15 deg is a PLACEHOLDER.
